content_html:
If you’re looking for an authentic travel experience away from the crowds, Choquequirao is one of the most impressive and least explored destinations in Peru.

Known as the “sacred sister” of Machu Picchu, this archaeological site offers a deeper connection with nature, history, and the true spirit of the Andes.

Why is Choquequirao a More Sustainable Travel Option?

Unlike overcrowded destinations, Choquequirao maintains a limited number of visitors, allowing for:

  • Lower environmental impact
  • More authentic travel experiences
  • Preservation of the natural surroundings
  • Better-controlled tourism

It’s ideal for travelers seeking responsible and sustainable tourism in Peru.

Where is Choquequirao Located?

Choquequirao is located in the Cusco region, in a remote area surrounded by mountains, deep valleys, and unique biodiversity.

Getting there isn’t easy… and that’s exactly what makes it special.

The Experience: More Than a Destination, It’s an Adventure

Reaching Choquequirao requires a challenging trek, but it’s absolutely worth it:

  • Hiking through Andean and jungle landscapes
  • Direct contact with untouched nature
  • Complete disconnection from mass tourism
  • Breathtaking views you won’t find on traditional routes

This is not a trip for everyone… it’s for those seeking something real.

Choquequirao vs Machu Picchu

A clear comparison

Choquequirao

Few tourists
Authentic experience
Strong connection with nature
Ideal for sustainable travel

Machu Picchu

Easier access
Developed infrastructure
Iconic experience
High tourist demand

If you’re looking for exclusivity and sustainability, Choquequirao is the winner.

Positive Impact on Local Communities

The Choquequirao trek supports:

  • Local job creation
  • Work with local guides and muleteers
  • Support for rural economies
  • Promotion of responsible tourism

Your trip truly makes a difference here.

What You Should Know Before Visiting

This is not a conventional tour:

  • Requires good physical condition
  • Multi-day trekking
  • Limited infrastructure
  • A more raw and authentic experience

And that’s exactly what makes it unforgettable.

Is Choquequirao the Future of Tourism in Cusco?

Many experts consider Choquequirao a model for the future:

Less overcrowding
Better tourism control
High-value travel experiences
Real sustainable tourism

This is the type of tourism that is growing worldwide.

Experience a Different Side of Peru

If you’ve already visited Machu Picchu or are looking for something deeper, Choquequirao is your next adventure.

At GT Peru Travel, we design responsible, safe, and authentic experiences, working directly with local communities.

Discover our Choquequirao tour packages and experience the true spirit of the Andes.
